title: Blackmire Swamp Temple
subtitle: Temple dungeon (Sclavus and Mosswarts). The Burun carry the journal outdoors
steps: In the Facility Hub, ask the Warden about Blackmire (level 45+).
The Burun Ruuk village is outdoors near 21.7S, 47.7E, by the temple. Kill Burun there for the Marked Fleshy Journal.
Take the journal to Translator Laokhe, atop the tower in Arwic at 33.5N, 56.8E.
Bring what Laokhe gives you back to the Warden.

notes.title: Burun are outside
notes.body: No Burun spawn inside the temple dungeon. It holds Sclavus, Mosswarts and Golems. The Burun carrying the texts are in the village outdoors. This map is only for the temple nearby.

notes.title: Journal
notes.body: The data does not place the Marked Fleshy Journal. It drops from the Burun (inferred from the Warden text).

notes.title: Best damage
notes.body: Sclavus take bludgeon best (0.46) and are weak to nothing else. Mosswart Chief takes cold 0.38 and acid 0.3.
